reviews.text:
I absolutely love skincare products that contain mugwort (Artemisia) because they do wonders for reducing redness and calming inflammation.
I loved this toner from the very first use. It doesn't leave any sticky residue, and thanks to the rice extract, it also provides extra nourishment for the skin.
My skin feels completely soothed, calm, and ready for the rest of my skincare routine.
Highly recommended! 🙌❤️
reviews.zh:
我一直都好鍾意含有艾草（Artemisia）嘅護膚品，因為佢哋對減低紅位、舒緩發炎效果好好。
我一用呢款化妝水就好鍾意。佢唔會留低黏膩嘅殘留，而且因為有米萃取，佢仲可以為皮膚提供額外嘅滋養。
我嘅皮膚感覺好舒緩、平靜，準備好接住落嚟嘅護膚程序。
強烈推薦！🙌❤️

reviews.text: I have never been so impressed so quickly by a skincare product. I’ve been using for a month now but even within a few days my skin was noticeably softer, brighter, and less inflamed. This toner completely repaired my barrier after a bad round of actives and keeps it plump and glowing, I have extremely sensitive, dry, acne-prone, folliculitis-prone skin and have autoimmune and other health issues that make it so hard to find safe but effective products. I’ll never be without this again!!
reviews.zh: 我從來未試過一款護膚品咁快令我咁驚喜。我用咗一個月，但係幾日之內皮膚已經明顯更加柔軟、亮白，發炎亦都減少咗。呢款化妝水完全修復咗我嘅屏障，經過一輪強效成分之後，令皮膚保持飽滿、有光澤。我嘅皮膚好敏感、乾燥、易生暗瘡、易生毛囊炎，仲有自身免疫同其他健康問題，所以好難搵到安全又有效嘅產品。我以後絕對唔會冇咗呢款！！

reviews.text: I recently incorporated this skincare product into my daily routine, and overall, I’ve had a positive experience. The texture feels smooth and absorbs well without leaving a heavy or greasy residue. After consistent use, I noticed my skin felt softer, more balanced, and hydrated, with a healthy glow.
reviews.zh: 我最近將呢款護膚品加入咗我嘅日常護理，整體嚟講，我嘅體驗好正面。質地順滑，吸收得好，唔會留低厚重或者油膩嘅殘留。持續使用之後，我感覺皮膚更加柔軟、平衡、水潤，仲有健康嘅光澤。

reviews.text: Me encantó este tónico, porque no tiene fragancia, ni aroma, es herbal, pero demasiado ligero, casi imperceptible , Tiene una consistencia ligera, no se siente para nada pesado, pero no es consistencia de agua a mi piel, le ha caído muy bien hasta el momento y me ha gustado mucho como me deja la piel, cómo se siente y todo
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款化妝水，因為佢冇任何香味，亦冇氣味，係草本嘅，但係太輕，幾乎感覺唔到。質地輕盈，唔會覺得重，但係唔係好似水咁嘅質地。到目前為止，我嘅皮膚都好適應，我好鍾意佢令皮膚嘅感覺，同埋其他所有嘢。

reviews.text: Je suis un peu déçue par ce tonner. Il n'est pas mauvais mais je m'attendais à beaucoup mieux. Il est vegan, ça c'est un bon point, en 200ml c'est aussi un bon point. J'ai une peau mixte, mature et très sensible. Parfois 'ai des rougeurs et démangaisons du au temps sec et foid ou au rétinoïnes que j'applique sur ma peau. Je trouve que ce toner n'a rien de spécial, il n'a pas cet effet calmant frais comme celui au thé vert de Isntree. Bien sûr il est bien tolléré par ma peau mais n'est pas exceptionnel. Je ne le rachèterai pas.
reviews.zh: 我對呢款化妝水有啲失望。唔係話差，但係我本身期望高好多。佢係純素嘅，呢點好；200ml 嘅容量都係一個好處。我嘅皮膚係混合性、成熟，而且非常敏感。有時我會因為天氣乾燥寒冷，或者我塗嘅維 A 酸類成分（rétinoïnes）而泛紅同痕癢。我覺得呢款化妝水冇乜特別，冇 Isntree 綠茶化妝水嗰種清涼舒緩嘅效果。當然，我嘅皮膚對佢都耐受，但係並唔突出。我唔會再買。

reviews.text: i have oily dehydrated sensitive skin and this toner is so hydrating and nourishing to my skin but remains lightweight, its soothing and calms my skin thanks to the artemisia. It helped my dark spots to fade faster and keep my face clear. for me its a multitask toner so i love using it when i’m in a hurry and i don’t have time to use multiple toners and wait for each of them to dry. its already hydrating, nourishing, calming and helps with acne marks.
reviews.zh: 我嘅皮膚油性、脫水、敏感，呢款化妝水好滋潤、好有營養，但係質地依然輕盈，而且因為艾草（Artemisia）令我皮膚舒緩、平靜。佢幫我嘅色斑更快淡化，令面部保持清晰。對我嚟講，佢係一款多用途化妝水，趕時間嗰時用，唔使用幾款化妝水，亦唔使等每一款乾先。佢已經可以補水、滋養、舒緩，仲有助改善暗瘡印。

reviews.text: I noticed how my small brown-ish spots on my cheeks got readily out of the sight lol. it's super hydrating and gives that dewy look when applied twice. my skin tone brightened as well. the only regret is that I should have bought more of this lol. So def gonna repurchase soon.
reviews.zh: 我留意到面頰上嘅小小啡色斑點，好容易就睇唔到咗 lol。佢超級補水，塗兩次之後會有水潤嘅光澤感。膚色亦都亮咗。唯一遺憾係我應該買多啲。所以我好快會再買。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
